metadata.title: Vintage Americana Psychedelic Rock Album Cover

recipe.visualDefinition: A group portrait of a six-member rock band in a cluttered, vintage Americana environment, framed by a thick white border with bold slab-serif typography at the top and bottom. The central image features a heavy 'cracked glass' or 'spiderweb' texture overlay, giving it a weathered, antique appearance.
coreVisualRelationships: Text-to-border alignment creating a formal frame
Warm, desaturated interior lighting contrasting with bright white margins
Layered depth between the band members and the cluttered background objects
Textural tension between the clean vector-like text and the distressed photo
coreInvariants: Thin black inner stroke framing the photograph
Spiderweb-like distressing across the central image
Slab-serif display type with high-contrast outlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Six men arranged in a triangular formation, occupying the central 80% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the foreground with long hair and a white ruffled shirt.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large red and blue title at the top, moves down through the band members' faces, and settles on the tracklist at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy white margins provide breathing room for the dense, textured central photograph.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep browns and reds (interior shadows and clothing)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Primary Red and Cyan Blue (used in title typography)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the photograph to mimic aged film; high value contrast in the typography for legibility.
paletteRestrictions: Muted earth tones for the image
Primary red and blue for accents

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with rounded terminals and thick strokes.
letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight in the main body
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ampersand is stylized and thinner than the surrounding letters
Letters have a slight 'bubble' quality to the serifs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Unified family pairing using different weights and scales of the same slab-serif genre.
graphicDevices: Circular logo icon in bottom right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rounded, heavy 70s slab aesthetic.
Provides the necessary slab weight for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a 1970s rock band in a cluttered room with vintage Americana decor (flags, old signs, gas pumps). Apply a heavy 'cracked glass' or 'spiderweb' texture overlay and a warm, faded film filter. Place this within a square frame with a thin black border and wide white margins.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large display title in the top margin using a heavy, outlined slab-serif font. Add two lines of smaller, bold slab-serif text in the bottom margin, centered. Include a small circular graphic icon in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the white border thick and consistent?
Does the central image have a visible cracked/distressed texture?
Is the top text outlined with a double stroke?
Are the band members arranged in a multi-layered group portrait?

adjustableVariables: Color of the display text (red/blue vs other primary pairs)
Specific Americana props in the background
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the title and tracklist

mustAchieve: Authentic 1970s film grain and color grading
avoid: Glow or drop shadow effects on text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the central image.
Check that the 'cracked' texture looks like physical damage, not a digital filter.
Verify the slab serifs are chunky and prominent.
Confirm the color palette remains grounded in earth tones and primary accents.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a group portrait in a cluttered retro setting with a heavy white border and bold, outlined slab-serif typography, unified by a distressed physical texture overlay.
